# Chaira Harder

> Chaira Harder is the co-founder and CEO of Asaply (https://asaply.ai/), a New York City startup building a text-first AI assistant for real-world errands, and a software engineer at UNIS in New York City. Chaira holds a bachelor's degree in Computer Science from Smith College.

Chaira co-founded Asaply after building its first version at OpenAI's GPT-5 Startup Hackathon in New York City, where it placed Top 6 of 300 engineers. People text asaply over iMessage/SMS to get coffee, lunch, tickets, rides, and pickups handled without downloading an app. Chaira leads Asaply's team of 10.

## Current roles

- Co-founder & CEO, Asaply Inc. (New York, NY), April 2026–present: https://asaply.ai/
- Software Engineer, United Nations International School (UNIS) (New York, NY), June 2025–present: builds internal systems and tools that automate manual workflows.
- Founder & Software Engineer, NextNode LLC, 2023–present: custom websites and iOS apps for 20+ clients. https://nextnode.technology/

## Highlights

- Finalist (Top 6 of 300), OpenAI GPT-5 Startup Hackathon, New York City: built Asaply.
- 7th of 600, Dell & NVIDIA AI Summit Hackathon (Dec 2025): built Relooped, an agentic DJ platform. https://relooped.vercel.app/
- Top 6 Finalist, UBS × Anthropic AI FinTech Hackathon: built ValueSpotter, a computer-vision valuation tool for M&A firms.
- People's Choice Award, Joy Entrepreneurship Challenge, Smith College (2024).
